correctness.rationale: An explicit induction on n proves pair-inclusion independence over C: the n=3 basis is direct; subtracting leaf-attachment trees and the complete-graph exchange lemma forces mixed coefficients to be independent of the attachment point; the n-1 induction fixes old-pair coefficients; near-star and full-star trees eliminate all remaining weights. The fixed-edge-count identities span all degree-at-most-two relations by dimension and coefficient independence. The exact modular checker independently corroborates the result for n=3..6 but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The quadratic Walsh band is the first nontrivial interaction level for complete-graph edge coordinates; at the next level, triangles already yield identically absent monomials. The exact all-order rank and entire dependency basis identify which pairwise edge interactions remain recoverable from spanning-tree samples, for arbitrary strictly positive tree weights. This is a natural structural classification rather than a narrow numerical table or textbook rank calculation.
